name: Dongguan Development (Holdings) Co., Ltd.
summary: Dongguan Development (Holdings) Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the financing and building of expressways within Dongguan, China. Complementing its infrastructure work, the company also extends services in financial leasing and commercial factoring. Originally named Guangdong Fudi Technology Co., Ltd., the firm later rebranded to its current designation. Its operations are headquartered in Dongguan, China.
